_about: Track S (SEM pilots) dataset registry, 2026-10-07. Facts come from the SEM multimodal screen and an independent check of repository records (claude/20261006_sem_multimodal_datasets.md). fetch_s.py resolves every file list from the repository API at run time and never trusts the expected_* fields, which serve only as a cross-check. Tier 1 = desk checks and pilot, tier 2 = second route, tier 3 = everything else.

datasets.title: NIST AM Bench 2022 AMB2022-03 IN718 single tracks and pads: SEM, EBSD and EDS cross sections, optical cross sections, thermography
datasets.license: NIST open license (https://www.nist.gov/open/license), shown on data.nist.gov, absent from DataCite

parts.what: SEM, EBSD and EDS cross sections (Traces/, Pads/, 2775_README.txt, measurement PDF)
parts.tier_note: V4-E21 (2026-10-07): the landing page lists 10,747 files, 3.37 TB (raw .ebsp patterns 2.66 TB, raw EDS .raw cubes 0.58 TB, Aztec .dat 90 GB). Tier 1 keeps SEM TIFFs, .ctf and .oipx exports, README and PDFs (~8 GB); tier 2 the .h5oina and CSV exports (~31 GB); tier 3 the raw patterns and cubes. V4-E22 (2026-10-07 02:00): .ctf moved to tier 2 because data.nist.gov returns HTTP 524 (origin timeout) on the ~70 MB .ctf files; the TIFF maps the S1 reader needs come first. V4-E23 (2026-10-07): tier 1 = documents and the single-track .ctf exports the S1 depth reader reads (native 0.25 um step); TIFF maps (borders, no pixel tag) and pad .ctf to tier 2.
